description: This file contains unit tests for the Angular AppComponent using the Angular testing framework (Jasmine). It sets up the testing module, creates component instances, and verifies component creation and rendering behavior.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment asynchronously by configuring the testing module with AppComponent.

methods.name: it('should create the app')
methods.description: Tests whether an instance of AppComponent is successfully created.

methods.name: it(`should have the 'angular' title`)
methods.description: Verifies that the AppComponent has the title property set to 'angular'.

methods.name: it('should render title')
methods.description: Checks that the component's rendered template contains the expected header text.
